d: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down after nearly 11 years with the company, at a crucial time as the e-commerce giant prepares for a potential IPO. Balaji Thiagarajan will help lead the business on an interim basis. Krishnamurthy's exit comes amid uncertainty over Flipkart's listing plans, rising competition from Amazon, quick-commerce platforms and Meesho, and a series of senior leadership changes. During his tenure, Flipkart's business grew more than fivefold, according to the company.
